topic: Greater Sunrise — Sep 2025 Timor-based LNG (TLNG) Cooperation Agreement and mid-2026 concept selection
wiki_text: After Woodside's CEO described Greater Sunrise as 'mired in diplomatic and regulatory complexity' and stalled in May 2025, the project advanced in September 2025 when Timor-Leste's Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources (MPRM) and Woodside Energy signed a Cooperation Agreement to mature a greenfield Timor-based LNG (TLNG) concept of approximately 5 million tonnes per annum, with an associated domestic-gas facility and a helium extraction plant. The agreement sets a target to select the concept/site for Greater Sunrise's LNG processing facilities by mid-2026, with first LNG potentially produced as early as 2032-2035, subject to concept selection and investment decisions. The Sunrise joint venture comprises TIMOR GAP (56.56%), operator Woodside (33.44%) and Osaka Gas Australia (10%). The development had earlier been informed by an independent Wood concept study (Apr-Nov 2024) concluding a Timor-based development was viable and most advantageous for Timor-Leste.
